## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain. It starts at s/n, Avenida Loro Parque.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The world's best zoo (according to TripAdvisor) is waiting to be discovered! Tenerife's Loro Parque is a zoo with a difference, taking its animals' health and happiness just as seriously as it does the spectacular acrobatic displays and interactive exhibitions. See thousands of animals in a beautiful tropical park!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €47.15. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 1042 ratings and 374 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
